description: Run-level cost of the screen. Replaces the pair-level 95.2% figure, which ignored the standalone evaluations C1 requires. Every number here is computed from the results files, and the GPU-hour figures are now MEASURED from the per-run seconds the runners print into results/*.log rather than assumed at 11.0 min/run.

pair_level_figure_for_contrast.note: This is the old 95.2%-style figure. It is a pair count and excludes the standalone runs C1 needs, so it overstates the saving.

timing.source: per-run seconds printed by the runners into results/*.log
timing.excluded: EMNIST-byclass arms (52 min/run) and the dose ladders, which are not CIFAR-10 pair evaluations at the headline config

gpu_hours.caveat: Measured, not assumed: per-run seconds come from the runner logs. The median carries the figure and the mean is reported beside it because the per-run distribution has a long right tail. Hardware is the single machine the paper describes, so these are wall-clock hours on it and not a portable cost.

scaling.screened: |attacks| * seeds * ((D-1) + |admitted|)  -- linear in D plus the admitted set
scaling.note: The screen removes the quadratic term. It does not remove experimentation: C1 is an empirical gate, so the standalone runs are unavoidable.
